$comment: orrery on the Strata driver (RFC 0027): headless, driven through Strata's drive channel, no X server. A driven orrery never reads or writes mission records. No probe yet: screenshot-only. Pass --date for a repeatable sky.
name: orrery-strata
title: orrery
description: the solar system from JPL data on Strata: watch the planets move at any rate, focus bodies, then board a ship and fly missions (Strata driver: headless; --clock stepped repeats frame for frame)

build.command: python3 tools/fetch_data.py all && python3 tools/build_catalog.py && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build --target orrery -j4

cheats: Do not pass --autopilot or --land unless your goal says so.

smoke.description: Watch the inner planets, speed time up, cycle the focus and zoom, with screenshots

goals.goal: Find your way around the solar system and fly the first mission as a player who has never seen the program; note every moment of confusion.
